title: Exit with error after inserting new line

body:
<!-- Before reporting: search existing issues and check the FAQ. -->

- `nvim --version`: v0.4.0-101-gfc4ca5b
- Vim (version: ) behaves differently? Doesn't exit
- Operating system/version: Ubuntu 16.04.5 LTS & OS X
- Terminal name/version: gnome-terminal 3.6.2 & iTerm2 3.2.6

### Steps to reproduce using `nvim -u NORC`

Doesn't reproduce using `nvim -u NORC`.

I'm using, at the very least, deoplete.

### Actual behaviour

```python
import logging

def work():
    logging.warning(▻'hello world')
```

Pressing enter with the cursor at the `▻` character causes neovim to exit immediately. There is some kind of error printed, but it disappears too quickly to catch.

### Expected behaviour

Neovim shouldn't exit.

### Additional Information

I know this is a pretty sparse bug report. If there's any kind of other information you'd like, just ask!
